record.body:
## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--retry-loop`. Code commits only there on `phase/retry-loop`. Do not edit `.artifacts/` or call `adaptive-artifacts`. Parallel task `retry-dashboard` owns `dashboard/` and dashboard tests with `-k attempt` — do not touch those paths.

Territory: `contract/`, `.artifacts/project-design.json` only if resolve sync requires it, `skills/execute-phase/`, `skills/plan-phase/`, `skills/verify-work/`, `tests/test_retry_loop.py`, and skill/contract consistency test touches.

Requirements (from specification retry-loop):
- R1: Before selecting planned ready work, execute-phase selects in_progress work-items needing retry and re-dispatches with same executor mode.
- R2: Each re-dispatch records assignment-amendment quoting failing check-run evidence and assessment Reason.
- R3: Each re-dispatch increments optional work-item payload attempts.
- R4: Closing verification failure creates fix work-item + depends_on on verification; never reopen done.
- R5: Hard retry budget (defaults 2 re-dispatches or 2× estimate_minutes; 3 fix tasks/phase); overrides in phase run facts; evidence ladder still routes.
- R6: Budget exhaustion → blocking continuity-question scope retry:<task-slug> + needs:human finding; stop dispatch.
- R7: plan-phase consumes next: plan by adding missing tasks and re-opening plan review.
- R9: Skills and contract stay consistent; focused tests cover the behaviors.

Design invariants: single writer; done is terminal; budget exhaustion always Needs you; fix tasks stay in current phase.
Design assumptions: runner output tails available; closing verification is the depends_on-all task; time budget best-effort from timestamps.

Decisions:
- retry-loop-scope: Full #7
- retry-budget: Hard budget backstop; evidence ladder unchanged for routing
- fix-task-shape: New fix work-item + depends_on; never reopen done
- next-plan-consume: plan-phase handles next: plan

Commit on the phase branch when done (exclude .artifacts). Return the evidence block only.
